paper_title: Integrating electronic health records and GWAS summary statistics to predict the progression of autoimmune diseases from preclinical stages
prediction_task: Binary prediction of progression from preclinical serology (RF+/ANA+) to diagnosed RA/SLE via Genetic Progression Score combining biobank EHR and GWAS summary statistics

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: UK Biobank was part of the case-control GWAS used to build CC-PRS, then reused for PheWAS validation - circular use of the same biobank in training weights and evaluation inflates CC-PRS signal.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added All of Us as independent PheWAS replication cohort (not in CC-PRS training); 4/5 RA GPS-PRS unique PheCodes replicated; effect-size correlations r2=0.44-0.70 across biobanks support validity.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Portability across ancestries and biobanks unexamined; performance reported only in European-ancestry subset of BioVU+All of Us; non-European sample sizes too small to evaluate fairness/transferability.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Evaluated African and American-ancestry cohorts (n>100) in All of Us; reported R2 for GPS-PRS-CS and GPS-Lassosum in non-European subgroups; acknowledged East Asian sample too small for reliable evaluation.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Only MTAG (2018) used as multi-trait PRS comparator; newer methods (mtPGS, multivariate Lassosum Bahda 2023, PROSPER) omitted, weakening novelty claim.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added multivariate Lassosum (Bahda 2023) comparator and super-stacking models (GPS_stacking/MTAG_stacking/TL-PRS_stacking/ALL-BASE_stacking); GPS retained top accuracy.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Tuning-parameter settings, software versions for LDpred2/lassosum/PRS-CS not documented; no code provided for baseline PRS estimation step.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Released baseline PRS training scripts at github.com/wangc29/GPS_paper_script; documented tuning grid and software versions in Methods Code Availability.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Preclinical stage defined only by RF+ and ANA+ serology; other informative markers (dsDNA, anti-Smith, CCP antibodies) excluded due to small counts, narrowing applicability.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Justified RF/ANA as primary clinical screening markers; reported dsDNA/anti-Smith/CCP case counts (17-130) too small for reliable modeling in BioVU/All of Us.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Confidence interval estimation method for R2 and AUPRC not described in original submission.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Clarified Nagelkerke R2 CI via CI.Rsq in psychometric R package; AUPRC/AUC via 1000-iteration bootstrap on test set. Added to Methods.
